parts.title: War of the Plants
parts.article:
A The general perception of plants is that they are defenceless when faced with threat from animals (including man), insects and other plants. This, however, is not the case. Plants are able to defend themselves against attack from their environment in many ways. There are two major features of plants that ensure their continuation as species. One of these relates to their physical attributes. Spinifex grass, a plant native to Australia, provides a notable example. Adapted to life in the hot, desert inland, spinifex has developed tightly rolled leaves which reduce the effects of drought stress. The hairs, or trichomes, which are found on the inner surface of the rolled-up spinifex leaf are believed to assist in minimising water loss. Trichomes also have defensive roles against predators. Many plants, such as the sunflower, have hairy leaves which are rough to the touch. When the plant is bitten by a grazing animal, the sensation is unpleasant on the tongue and the animal normally moves on to find more palatable food.

B Some families of plants such as the Solanaceae, which includes the tomato, the potato and other food plants, feature glandular trichomes. In these structures a tiny sac is carried on the hair, which rises from the epidermis, or skin, of the plant. The sac contains chemicals which may perform a range of functions. For example, an insect landing on a tomato leaf and rupturing the sac is exposed to a toxic chemical which will deter it from feeding on that plant in future. In other plants of the same family, the sacs contain a natural adhesive and the unsuspecting insect landing on such a leaf and rupturing a trichome sac is held onto the plant, unable to depart. In the leaves of the nettle plant these trichomes resemble miniature hypodermic syringes. An irritant chemical is stored at the base of the ‘syringe’. If an animal touches it, a shot of the chemical is discharged through the ‘needle’ and into the skin of the animal. The irritation the chemical causes is a deterrent against future threat.

C The poisons and glues of the Solanaceae and the irritant of the nettle indicate the other major method of plant survival: that some plants use chemicals to protect themselves, sometimes from each other. Chemical interactions that occur between plants are known as ‘allelopathy’, and in natural plant communities it is one of many factors which determine how plants grow in relation to one another. An example in Australia is the suppression of vegetation growth beneath eucalypt trees, an effect which decreases with increasing distance from the trunk of the tree.

D The most detailed studies of allelopathy have generally been carried out on agricultural plant communities. In agriculture, allelopathy has been identified particularly with weeds, which compete with desired crop or pasture species, such as wheat, oats and grass, for environmental resources. Competition can be physical, where the growth of one plant maximises the use of water, nutrients and light to the disadvantage of another. Allelopathy, on the other hand, involves plant-produced chemicals which may poison a neighbouring plant. On the whole, weeds are far more physically and chemically aggressive than crop and pasture species. As an example, recent research on the common thorn apple, Datura stramonium, a weed found throughout Australia, has found that two powerful chemicals are released from the seed during the early stages of germination. In fact, it is necessary for the chemicals to be released from the seed coat so that the seed can germinate. Once released, the chemicals then provide a barrier that inhibits the growth of any potential plant competitor near the thorn apple seedling.

E Allelopathic chemicals function in quite subtle ways. Generally they are active in small quantities, they are effective only with certain other plants, they act by disrupting the plant’s natural processes and they have no known residual effects. It has also been found that the activity of these chemicals may be synergistic, that is, two or more such substances may combine to produce an effect that is greater than the effects of the substances acting in isolation. These are the very attributes which are being targeted in the current development of synthetic herbicides*. Allelopathy is not restricted to weeds in agriculture, but allelopathic activity in crop and pasture plants appears to have diminished, possibly because plant breeders may have concentrated on improving aspects of crop quality and quantity rather than aspects of defence against natural enemies.

F Allelopathic chemicals may be harvested for development as ‘natural herbicides’, similar to the harvest of pyrethrins from the pyrethrum daisy for use as natural insecticides. Harnessing allelopathy is highly attractive to the farming industry, as at least half of the more than A$200-million annual cost of crop protection in Australia is spent on herbicides. Enhancing allelopathic activity in crop and pasture plants could reduce this enormous bill. Developing and harvesting natural herbicides might also offer real advantages in addressing environmental concerns about the over-use of synthetic chemicals currently used in crop protection. In many parts of the world, communities are showing an increased willingness to pay a premium for products grown with few or no synthetic chemicals, and natural products are becoming increasingly attractive.

Q26 The two main points of this article are that plants can defend themselves in a number of ways, and that

  • A combating weeds is a major problem for Australian farmers.
  • B considerable research has been carried out into the use of plant chemicals.
  • C Australian plants have unique methods of self-protection.
  • D chemicals found in weeds can have practical benefits for agriculture.

reference:
Q14

句子 As an example, recent research on the common thorn apple, Datura stramonium, a weed found throughout Australia, has found that two powerful chemicals are released from the seed during the early stages of germination. In fact, it is necessary for the chemicals to be released from the seed coat so that the seed can germinate.

干扰 你可能会在其他段落盲目寻找“reproduction”这个词，但雅思阅读喜欢用具体的场景词（如这里的germination发芽）来进行同义替换。

解析 D段提到曼陀罗（thorn apple）在种子发芽（germination）的早期阶段会释放化学物质，发芽正是植物的繁殖过程。

Q15

句子 In other plants of the same family, the sacs contain a natural adhesive and the unsuspecting insect landing on such a leaf and rupturing a trichome sac is held onto the plant, unable to depart.

干扰 你可能会觉得glue（胶水）一定是人造的，但在原文中被替换成了“natural adhesive”（天然黏合剂）。

解析 B段明确说明有些植物的液囊里含有天然黏合剂（natural adhesive），昆虫碰到就会被粘住无法逃脱。

Q16

句子 One of these relates to their physical attributes. Spinifex grass, a plant native to Australia, provides a notable example. Adapted to life in the hot, desert inland, spinifex has developed tightly rolled leaves which reduce the effects of drought stress. The hairs, or trichomes, which are found on the inner surface of the rolled-up spinifex leaf are believed to assist in minimising water loss. Trichomes also have defensive roles against predators. Many plants, such as the sunflower, have hairy leaves which are rough to the touch.

干扰 你可能会因为B段有大量关于防卫的描写而选错，但B段讲的全是释放毒素、黏液等化学（chemical）手段，不符合题干的“non-chemical”。

解析 A段介绍了植物利用物理特征（非化学方法）进行防御的两个例子：澳洲三芒草（Spinifex）和向日葵（sunflower）。

Q17

句子 Chemical interactions that occur between plants are known as ‘allelopathy’, and in natural plant communities it is one of many factors which determine how plants grow in relation to one another.

干扰 后面的D、E、F段虽然也大量出现了allelopathy，但只有C段给出了它最初的定义（definition）。

解析 C段用“are known as”这个经典的下定义短语，直接解释了什么是植物相克（allelopathy）。

Q18

句子 The sac contains chemicals which may perform a range of functions. For example, an insect landing on a tomato leaf and rupturing the sac is exposed to a toxic chemical which will deter it from feeding on that plant in future. In other plants of the same family, the sacs contain a natural adhesive and the unsuspecting insect landing on such a leaf and rupturing a trichome sac is held onto the plant, unable to depart. In the leaves of the nettle plant these trichomes resemble miniature hypodermic syringes. An irritant chemical is stored at the base of the ‘syringe’. If an animal touches it, a shot of the chemical is discharged through the ‘needle’ and into the skin of the animal. The irritation the chemical causes is a deterrent against future threat.

干扰 C段和D段也提到了化学物质，但那是植物用来对付其他植物（竞争者）的，只有B段明确描述了用来击退捕食者（动物和昆虫）。

解析 B段详细列举了番茄、荨麻等植物如何通过释放毒性或刺激性化学物质，来击退想要吃它们的捕食者（predators）。

Q19

句子 Allelopathic chemicals may be harvested for development as ‘natural herbicides’, similar to the harvest of pyrethrins from the pyrethrum daisy for use as natural insecticides. Harnessing allelopathy is highly attractive to the farming industry, as at least half of the more than A$200-million annual cost of crop protection in Australia is spent on herbicides. Enhancing allelopathic activity in crop and pasture plants could reduce this enormous bill. Developing and harvesting natural herbicides might also offer real advantages in addressing environmental concerns about the over-use of synthetic chemicals currently used in crop protection.

干扰 你可能看到D段提到了农业和杂草就选了D，但D段讲的是杂草带来的危害，只有F段才讲了利用这些化学物质带来的积极好处。

解析 F段指出了把植物化学物质开发成“天然除草剂”用在农业上的好处（benefits）：既能省钱，又能保护环境。

Q20

句子 Allelopathic chemicals function in quite subtle ways. Generally they are active in small quantities, they are effective only with certain other plants, they act by disrupting the plant’s natural processes and they have no known residual effects.

干扰 题目要找的是“特征”（characteristics），原文并没有直接用这个词，而是用了一长串排比句描述，并在后文总结为“attributes”。

解析 E段开篇第一、二句话直接罗列了这类化学物质的几个特征，如作用微妙、量小、针对性强、无残留等。

Q21

句子 Spinifex grass, a plant native to Australia, provides a notable example. Adapted to life in the hot, desert inland, spinifex has developed tightly rolled leaves which reduce the effects of drought stress. The hairs, or trichomes, which are found on the inner surface of the rolled-up spinifex leaf are believed to assist in minimising water loss.

干扰 你可能会把视线完全集中在“防御捕食者”上，从而忽略了A段前半部分的重点是这种物理结构能帮助植物保水（conserve water）。

解析 A段举了澳洲三芒草（Spinifex）的例子，说明它通过卷曲的叶片和内部绒毛这一物理特征来保存水分（minimising water loss）。

Q22

句子 Some families of plants such as the Solanaceae, which includes the tomato, the potato and other food plants, feature glandular trichomes. ... In the leaves of the nettle plant these trichomes resemble miniature hypodermic syringes.

干扰 你可能觉得荨麻和前面提到的番茄、土豆不是同一种类，就不属于腺毛了，但原文的代词“these trichomes”清楚地表明它们同属此类结构。

解析 原文B段先提出了“腺毛（glandular trichomes）”的概念，随后顺承指出荨麻叶片里的“这些腺毛（these trichomes）”就像微型注射器，表述完全一致。

Q23

句子 There are two major features of plants that ensure their continuation as species. One of these relates to their physical attributes. ... The poisons and glues of the Solanaceae and the irritant of the nettle indicate the other major method of plant survival: that some plants use chemicals to protect themselves, sometimes from each other.

干扰 你可能会主观觉得有化学武器的植物肯定更厉害、长得更好，但只要原文没有明确进行比较，就一定要选NOT GIVEN。

解析 原文虽然分别介绍了植物的物理防御和化学防御，但全篇根本没有将这两种依靠不同特征生存的植物放在一起比较“谁长得更成功”。

Q24

句子 It has also been found that the activity of these chemicals may be synergistic, that is, two or more such substances may combine to produce an effect that is greater than the effects of the substances acting in isolation. These are the very attributes which are being targeted in the current development of synthetic herbicides.

干扰 你如果漏看了原文里的“two or more such substances may combine”（两种或以上结合），就很容易把这个题错判为TRUE或者NOT GIVEN。

解析 原文明确指出目前的合成除草剂研发针对的是化学物质的“协同作用”（两种或以上物质结合），而不是题目所说的单一物质（individual）。

Q25

句子 Harnessing allelopathy is highly attractive to the farming industry, as at least half of the more than A$200-million annual cost of crop protection in Australia is spent on herbicides.

干扰 你可能一看到A$200 million就非常激动直接选了TRUE，却忽略了前面至关重要的定语“at least half of”（至少一半）。

解析 原文F段说明，这2亿多澳元是整个农作物保护的钱，而花在除草剂上的钱只占了其中的一部分（至少一半），并非全部。

Q26

句子 Enhancing allelopathic activity in crop and pasture plants could reduce this enormous bill. Developing and harvesting natural herbicides might also offer real advantages in addressing environmental concerns about the over-use of synthetic chemicals currently used in crop protection.

干扰 你可能会被B选项（大量研究）迷惑，但这只是过程，不是文章的最终落脚点；D选项准确涵盖了文章后半段将植物化学物质变现于农业的核心主旨。

解析 文章前半部分盘点了植物自身的物理和化学防卫机制，后半部分（重点）则升华了主题，说明我们可以利用杂草的这些化学特性开发天然除草剂，为农业带来实际利益（practical benefits）。
